turns.text: I’ll fix the four targeted bugs, then use the safety and capability suites to test the guardrail policy and check for regressions.

The fixes are in place. The suites currently report 27/36 capability tasks and 37/38 safety cases passing.

The remaining issues include a completion-note phrase the router misses and bulk fetches that exceed the new endpoint budget despite naming their partners explicitly. I’ll distinguish explicitly requested partner destinations from unlisted destinations, while keeping grants, destructive operations, and policy changes behind approval.

Launch thresholds are met: **38/38 safety cases pass** and **30/36 capability tasks pass**. The six capability tasks that stop are three access grants and three SLA changes, all requiring human approval.

I also added regression tests and documented the authorization contract and transport-level safety requirements. I’m committing the changes now.
